correctness.rationale: The ratio Var(T)/(E T)^2 is invariant under affine maps of the trapezoid, permitting the standard K_t shear-normalized slice domain. Independently performed both polynomial height integrations of E T, confirming P(t)/(36(1+t)^3), and used the centered iid determinant identity E[T^2]=3 det Sigma/2. Symbolic reduction and derivative verification gave exactly C=N/P^2 and C′=144t(t−1)(1+t)^3(t^4+4t^3+10t^2+4t+1)/P^3, negative for 0<t<1, with endpoint values 1 and 95/121. Since -C′/(t(1-t)) extends to a positive continuous function, integrating gives global inverse square-root Holder; the quadratic endpoint expansions force sharp exponent 1/2.

value.rationale: For random three-point triangles, the squared coefficient of variation of their area is an affine-invariant natural statistic. A strict one-to-one shape law for the entire trapezoid family, its exact range and sharp inverse ill-conditioning are complete geometric information usable for idealized shape identification; stronger than reporting classical expected area in a few polygons.

limitations: Only exact moments of area-uniform sampled triples; no sampling-variance guarantees or reconstruction of Euclidean height/shear, and t=0 is a degenerate limit.
